description: This file defines the RuleCreator class which provides a static method to create different rule objects based on the specified type. It is part of the AWS SDK's EndpointV2 rules component.

classes.name: RuleCreator
classes.description: Provides a static method to instantiate rule objects based on rule type.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns specific rule objects ('EndpointRule', 'ErrorRule', 'TreeRule') based on the provided type, or throws an exception if the type is unknown.
